purpose: Broad-spectrum dewormer — treats large & small strongyles, tapeworms, ascarids, and bots.
howto:
Administer full syringe orally per body weight per label directions. Deworm on the rotation schedule set with your vet.
Autumn/Early Winter (Post-First Hard Frost): The most critical time for deworming. All horses should be treated with Ivermectin or Moxidectin combined with Praziquantel to clear out bots and tapeworms before winter.
Spring (May): Perform an FEC to determine your horse's shedder status. If treatment is needed, a broad-spectrum dewormer is generally used.
notes: Ivermectin / Praziquantel
